# Requirements

Today Neo only auto-recalls on the FIRST turn of a conversation (cmRelevancePush, turnSeq==1) and its recall reaches memory summaries, never the verbatim past exchange: the cortex session store (sess/) is durable but has NO search surface of any kind, the HNSW embedder indexes memories only, RecallDescend bottoms out at memory leaves, and consolidator-written memories carry no pointer back to the session messages they came from. So when the user says 'remember when we discussed X' mid-conversation, Neo either reconstructs from assumption (the exact failure class epistemic-core targets) or must be lucky with a reactive memory_recall call. DEJA-VU closes this in four moves. (1) Provenance: the writeback consolidator stamps a derived_from edge from every memory it writes to the matrix://cortex/session/<conv>/<seq> refs of the turn that produced it, making every future memory an exact pointer into its source transcript. (2) Detection: a deterministic trigger lexicon over the raw user message (zero-latency, fail-open) gates a single cheap-lane extraction call that yields a clean search referent and a time hint. (3) Retrieval + feed: a bounded episodic pipeline — semantic HNSW Find over memories, provenance-edge follow to the verbatim Transcript slice, and (wave 3) a BM25-style lexical index over sess/ built as a replay-safe derived lane — fused by reciprocal rank, rendered as an episodic block appended to the cmTail in prepareTurn, so the exact past exchange is RESIDENT at generation time (never let the LLM assume). The feed channel is LOCKED (Andrew 2026-07-16): cmTail primary, Cassandra failsafe; the user turn itself is never modified. (4) Failsafe + surface: a new deterministic Cassandra doubt trigger fires when an episodic reference was detected but the model closes without any surfaced grounding, and the client timeline shows what was recalled and from when. Everything new that touches cortex persists as derived records only — journal-rebuildable, no SMT writes, values vault-sealed below the hash boundary — with OverallRoot byte-identity proven, because this feature touches the most important system in Matrix and inherits custody-of-memory rigor.

## Requirement 1: Provenance: memories point at their source transcript

**User Story:** As Neo, I want every memory the consolidator writes to carry an exact pointer back to the session messages it was extracted from, so that a memory hit can be expanded into the verbatim past exchange.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the writeback consolidator persists a memory (fact, user_fact, preference, correction, pattern, opportunity, outcome), it SHALL add a derived_from edge from the new memory URI to the matrix://cortex/session/<conversation>/<seq> URI(s) of the turn window it processed, using the conversation id and seq range the consolidator already knows at write time.
2. EDGE creation SHALL be best-effort per the fail-open doctrine for the write path (a failed edge never fails the memory write) but SHALL be journaled/anchored exactly like any canonical AddEdge when it succeeds.
3. A resolver SHALL expand a memory URI to its source transcript slice: follow derived_from edges to session refs, then read Transcript(conv, seq-N, seq+N) bounded by a configurable context radius; memories without provenance edges SHALL resolve via the fallback ladder (rollup window SeqLo/SeqHi + timestamp proximity) and be marked approximate.

## Requirement 2: Episodic trigger detection

**User Story:** As a user, when I say 'remember when', 'last time', 'you said', or reference a shared past event in my own words, I want Neo to notice deterministically and know what to search for, so that recall fires without me invoking a tool.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A deterministic trigger lexicon (compiled phrase/regex table over the raw user message: remembrance verbs, shared-past deixis, temporal deixis) SHALL classify each inbound user turn as episodic/not in O(message length) with zero model calls; the lexicon SHALL be table-driven and covered by table tests including negative cases (e.g. 'remember to buy milk' is NOT episodic).
2. WHEN the lexicon fires, ONE cheap-lane LLM extraction call SHALL produce {referent query, time hint, scope hint} from the user message; the call SHALL be deadline-bounded, and on failure or timeout the raw user message SHALL be used as the referent query (fail-open).
3. A parsed time hint (yesterday, last week, back in June, when we were doing X) SHALL map onto the retrieval time window / AsOf of the descent; absence of a time hint SHALL leave the default horizon.
4. DETECTION SHALL NOT run on heartbeat/automatrix wake markers, guidance messages, or non-user-authored turns.

## Requirement 3: Episodic retrieval pipeline

**User Story:** As Neo, I want a bounded pipeline that finds the exact past thing the user means, so that my answer quotes what actually happened instead of reconstructing it.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. LANE 1 (semantic): the pipeline SHALL run cortex Find with Near=<referent> over the HNSW memory index (reusing the existing pager Retrieve seed lanes), respecting the time window from req 2.3.
2. LANE 2 (exactness): top memory hits SHALL be expanded to verbatim transcript slices via the req 1.3 resolver, cross-conversation (the provenance edge carries the conversation id), with each excerpt carrying provenance metadata: conversation id, date, seq range, and whether exact or approximate.
3. LANE 3 (lexical, wave 3): the pipeline SHALL additionally query the derived lexical index over sess/ for exact-word matches and fuse all lanes by reciprocal rank fusion; before wave 3 the pipeline SHALL run lanes 1+2 only.
4. THE pipeline SHALL also rank the CURRENT conversation's older turns (beyond the Activate T2 tail) via the existing in-memory semantic recall lane, so same-conversation references resolve without cortex round-trips.
5. THE pipeline SHALL be budget-bounded (token cap on total excerpt content, hit-count cap, wall-clock deadline) and SHALL return empty on any internal failure (fail-open), never an error that blocks the turn.

## Requirement 4: The feed: episodic block on the cmTail (LOCKED channel)

**User Story:** As Neo, I want the recalled exchange resident in my window before I generate, so that my first token is grounded in memory, not assumption.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. cmRelevancePush SHALL be generalized: the turnSeq==1 relevance push remains as-is, and ANY turn whose user message triggers episodic detection SHALL additionally get an episodic block appended to the cmTail computed in prepareTurn — the single activation-assembly site; no other injection channel is used and the user turn in a.working is never modified.
2. THE episodic block SHALL render: a header stating this is an auto-recalled past exchange the user referenced, each excerpt with conversation/date/exactness provenance, related memory summaries, and an instruction to ground the answer in this material and say so plainly if it does not actually match what the user meant.
3. THE block SHALL be token-capped independently of the Activate bundle trim, and injected excerpt refs SHALL be tracked in the turn's surfaced sets so repeated triggers within one conversation do not re-inject identical excerpts.
4. WHEN the pipeline returns empty, NO block SHALL be injected and a turn-scoped episodicPending signal SHALL remain set for the Cassandra failsafe (req 6).

## Requirement 5: Derived lexical index over the session store

**User Story:** As a user, I want Neo to find the exact words I used weeks ago even when no memory was consolidated from them, so that verbatim references (that error about X, the name I mentioned) resolve.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. CORTEX SHALL maintain a lexical inverted index (deterministic tokenizer, BM25-style scoring) over sess/ message content as a DERIVED lane: postings persisted under a dedicated derived key family, built incrementally at AppendMessage time and rebuildable from the journal + sess/ records; NO SMT writes; rebuild SHALL be byte-deterministic.
2. INDEX values SHALL ride the existing cortex value-seal seam (vault-sealed below the hash boundary); OverallRoot and anchored SMT roots SHALL be proven byte-identical with the index present vs absent and across delete-then-rebuild.
3. A query surface SHALL return scored (conversation, seq) hits for a term/phrase query with a time-range filter, bounded by k, and SHALL be wired into the req 3 pipeline via reciprocal rank fusion.
4. THE fused hybrid (lexical + semantic) SHALL also back pager.Recall / the memory_recall tool for transcript-reaching queries, so reactive recall gains the same exact-match power as the automatic push.

## Requirement 6: Cassandra failsafe: trigEpisodicUngrounded

**User Story:** As the owner, I want a deterministic backstop when Neo answers about a shared past without grounding, so that the assume-then-pursue failure class cannot slip through the automatic push.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A new doubt-side trigger trigEpisodicUngrounded SHALL fire when: an episodic reference was detected this turn AND no episodic grounding was surfaced (empty pipeline result and no memory_recall call this turn) AND the assistant message is closing/answering; it SHALL fold a first-person nudge to check memory_recall before asserting the past.
2. THE trigger SHALL integrate via ONE new field on stepSignals (episodicPending, set in prepareTurn, cleared when grounding is surfaced or memory_recall runs); the Cassandra controller SHALL remain deterministic, transcript-blind, content-only, dual-recorded, and cooldown/cap-governed.
3. EXISTING trigger precedence, casMinStep, casMaxMods, and per-trigger cooldown behavior SHALL be preserved and proven unchanged for non-episodic turns.

## Requirement 7: Idle backfill: history gains provenance and postings

**User Story:** As a user with months of history, I want past sessions searchable and old memories linked to their sources, so that deja-vu works on what happened before this feature shipped.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A Chronos-scheduled idle sweep (sibling of the existing sweep conventions, reusing the busy-check/reschedule posture) SHALL walk historical sess/ records building lexical postings, and heuristically backfill derived_from edges for pre-existing memories (actor + CreatedAt + conversation containment), marking heuristic edges distinguishably from write-time exact edges.
2. THE sweep SHALL be idempotent, checkpointed (resumable after restart via a derived checkpoint record), bounded per wake (batch cap), and SHALL never run while a user turn is live (busy-check defers).
3. RE-RUNNING a completed sweep SHALL be a no-op (proven), and sweep state SHALL be derived-lane only.

## Requirement 8: Observability and client surface

**User Story:** As a user, I want to SEE Neo remembering — what it recalled, from when, from which conversation — so that automatic memory is legible instead of spooky.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE episodic push SHALL ride the existing memory.activation broker event (extended fields: excerpts with conversation/date/exactness, trigger phrase class), persisted via traceWorkspaceTypes so it survives reopen.
2. apps/client SHALL render the recalled excerpts in the existing memory/timeline surface (workspace event family, both web and story-so-far surfaces where present), following UI house rules (no borders/emojis/gradients/glow) with i18n across all 5 locales.
3. AN internal counter/log line SHALL record per-turn: trigger fired, lanes queried, hits, excerpt tokens injected, pipeline latency — enough to tune the lexicon and budgets from prod logs.

## Requirement 9: End-to-end and property verification (no fakes)

**User Story:** As the owner, I want the whole mechanism proven on real components — including that cortex integrity is untouched — so that the most important system in Matrix is demonstrably unharmed and the feature demonstrably works.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. AN end-to-end test on the real agent loop (real Pager, real Pebble cortex, httptest SSE LLM) SHALL prove: a consolidated memory from conversation A + a later 'remember when' user turn in conversation B yields an episodic block in the assembled window containing the verbatim conversation-A excerpt with correct provenance, and the model's window contains it BEFORE generation.
2. PROPERTY tests SHALL prove: OverallRoot/anchored-root byte-identity with lexical index on/off and across delete-then-rebuild; deterministic index rebuild (byte-identical postings from the same journal); replay byte-identity unchanged; fail-open under a broken embedder, a dead cheap-lane LLM, and a corrupted index (turn proceeds, no block, no error).
3. CASSANDRA tests SHALL prove trigEpisodicUngrounded fires exactly on (detected AND ungrounded AND closing), never otherwise, and that all pre-existing trigger behavior is byte-unchanged on non-episodic turns.
4. NO test in this feature SHALL substitute a fake for a real code path.
